snippet.title: (Audio Described) Games for Blind Gamers 4 - Accessibility Trailers - Access-Ability Summer Showcase
snippet.description: Hand picked for inclusion from this year's Games for Blind Gamers game jam, we share trailers for The Unseen Awakening, Lacus Opertunitas, Barista, and Necomancer Nonsense.
